name: make a school website with fee
prompt: make a school website with fees structure and necessary details .animated photos and all

project.name: Interactive School Web Application
project.summary: A comprehensive, animated school website featuring school details and a structured fee schedule.

explicit_requirements: Incorporate animated photos and visual elements

tasks.focus: Establish the visual theme, layout structure, color palette, typography, and animation styling for school sections and photo galleries.
Define the single-page component hierarchy, responsive layout, and integration of smooth CSS/JS animations and image assets.
Specify interactive components including navigation, fee structure calculator/table filtering, and interactive photo gallery behaviors.

design.theme: Vibrant Modern Educational Clean with Dynamic Animated Visuals

typography.scale: Type scale: H1 3rem, H2 2.25rem, H3 1.5rem, Body 1rem, Small 0.875rem with fluid scaling.

layout: Fixed sticky header with frosted-glass effect, logo, navigation links, and 'Apply Now' CTA button.
Hero section with headline, dynamic animated photo showcase/carousel, and quick call-to-action buttons.
About & School Details section featuring grid cards for mission, facilities, faculty, and achievements.
Interactive Fees Structure section with toggleable tabs (e.g., Primary, Secondary, Higher Secondary) and detailed fee breakdown tables.
Footer with quick links, contact information, social channels, and copyright notice.
responsive_behavior: Desktop: Full multi-column grid layouts (3-4 columns), spacious paddings, and side-by-side hero content.
Tablet: 2-column grids, collapsible navigation menu with hamburger toggle, adjusted typography scale.
Mobile: Single-column vertical stack, full-width cards, touch-optimized spacing, and floating quick-action menu.
visual_style: Cards feature clean borders (1px solid #e2e8f0), rounded corners (border-radius: 12px), and subtle box shadows (0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)).
Buttons utilize smooth hover transitions, scale transforms on hover (scale 1.02), and subtle shadow elevations.
animations: Subtle float and fade-in effects on hero photos using CSS keyframes.
Smooth accordion and tab transitions for the fees structure.
Scroll-triggered fade-in and slide-up animations for content cards and sections.

dom_structure: header#app-header: Nav with Logo, Navigation Links (Home, About, Academics, Admissions, Fees, Gallery, Contact), and Mobile Menu Toggle
main#app-main: Primary container holding all dynamic sections
section#hero: Hero banner with animated headline, background carousel/slideshow, and CTA buttons
section#about: School overview, mission, vision, and key statistics counter
section#academics: Programs, curriculum highlights, and faculty grid
section#fees: Interactive fee structure calculator/table with grade selectors and currency converter
section#gallery: Animated photo gallery with category filter tabs and lightbox modal trigger
section#admissions: Admission process steps and inline application inquiry form
section#contact: School contact info, embedded map placeholder, and contact form
footer#app-footer: Quick links, social icons, newsletter signup, and copyright
div#lightbox-modal: Reusable modal for expanded animated photo view
div#toast-container: Global notification alerts for form submissions and user actions

css_architecture.layout_strategy: CSS Grid for overall macro-layout and responsive card decks (fees, gallery, faculty). Flexbox for alignment in navigation, hero content, and form inputs. Smooth CSS keyframe animations for floating photos, fade-in reveals, and counter increments.
responsive_breakpoints: @media (max-width: 480px) for mobile layout adjustments and single-column stacks
@media (max-width: 768px) for tablet collapse menus and dual-column grids
@media (min-width: 1024px) for desktop widescreen layout with multi-column displays

js_architecture.state_schema: { currentSection: string, mobileMenuOpen: boolean, activeGalleryFilter: string, feeCalculator: { grade: string, paymentFrequency: string, optionalTransport: boolean, optionalBoarding: boolean }, notifications: Array<{id: string, message: string, type: string}> }
core_functions: initApp(): Initializes event listeners, renders initial templates, sets up intersection observers for scroll animations.
renderNavigation(): Dynamically renders top navigation and handles sticky header behavior on scroll.
renderHero(): Manages background animated photo slideshow rotation and CTA button handlers.
renderFeesTable(): Dynamically calculates and displays tuition, boarding, activity fees based on grade and options selected.
renderGallery(): Filters animated photo items based on active category tabs and initializes lightbox triggers.
openLightbox(imgSrc, caption): Displays high-res animated photo modal.
handleFormSubmit(event): Validates and processes admission inquiries or contact messages with toast alerts.
showToast(message, type): Triggers floating notification banner.
event_delegation: Delegated click listener on #app-header for mobile hamburger menu toggle and smooth-scrolling anchor navigation.
Delegated change/click listeners on #fees for dynamic grade selector calculation updates.
Delegated click listeners on #gallery for category filter buttons and photo item zoom.
Delegated submit listener for all forms (#admissions-form, #contact-form).

constraints: Single self-contained index.html file containing all markup, styles, and scripts
Zero external build steps or node module requirements (vanilla JS, embedded CSS, semantic HTML5)
Accessible semantic markup with ARIA roles, keyboard navigability, and high-contrast color tokens

features.name: School Overview and Hero Section
features.purpose: Provide an immediate engaging introduction to the school with animated imagery and essential branding.
features.interaction: User loads the page and scrolls through the hero banner; clicks call-to-action buttons to jump to details or fees.
features.behavior: Triggers CSS/JS entry animations on hero text and featured background photos. Smooth scrolls to target sections upon button click.
edge_cases: Reduced motion preferences honored via CSS media queries to disable heavy animations.

features.name: School Details and Information Hub
features.purpose: Display necessary school details such as mission, history, curriculum, faculty, and contact information.
features.interaction: User clicks navigation links or tabs to switch between different informational categories (About Us, Academics, Admissions, Contact).
features.behavior: Dynamically updates the active view or expands accordion panels to reveal corresponding textual and visual details without full page reloads.
edge_cases: Empty information state handling with fallback placeholders if data fails to load.

features.name: Interactive Fees Structure Table
features.purpose: Clearly present the tuition, admission, laboratory, and activity fees across different grade levels.
features.interaction: User selects a grade level filter or academic year dropdown to view specific fee breakdowns; can toggle installment plans.
features.behavior: Filters the fees data table or card grid in real-time and updates total calculations dynamically in the DOM.
edge_cases: Zero or unmatched search/filter results display a polite notification message with a reset button.
Clearing filter inputs restores the full default fees table view.

features.name: Animated Photos and Visual Gallery
features.purpose: Enhance user engagement by showcasing campus life, classrooms, and events through animated photo grids and carousels.
features.interaction: User hovers over photo cards to trigger zoom/tilt animations or clicks images to open an interactive lightbox viewer.
features.behavior: Applies CSS transform scaling on hover and mounts a modal overlay displaying the enlarged high-resolution image with caption.
edge_cases: Missing image URLs display a fallback placeholder graphic to prevent broken layout elements.

features.name: Online Admission Inquiry Form
features.purpose: Allow prospective parents to submit inquiries or application requests directly through the website.
features.interaction: User fills out form fields (student name, grade applying for, parent email, message) and clicks the submit button.
features.behavior: Validates form inputs client-side, displays inline error messages for invalid entries, and renders a success confirmation state upon valid submission.
edge_cases: Submitting with empty required fields triggers validation highlights and prevents submission.
Clearing the form resets all input fields and error states back to initial.
